messages:
Claire Gomez: Heads up  Cloud partner wants a one-click private offer flow in marketplace with immediate activation + a short-term migration credit. need cross-functional signoff.
Owen Park: ops note  marketplace requires mapped SKU and pricing metadata 48h before listing. can we support immediate activation if metadata is pending?
Sam (Legal): risk: public listing triggers disclosure. require a private-offer NDA clause and explicit embargo until listing date. also want renewal discount schedule in the offer.
Riya (Finance): cap on credits is a must. propose cap = min($50k, 10% of committed spend). accounting prefers credits as contra-revenue.
Claire Gomez: tradeoff: partner wants instant activation to close deals. propose: allow activation but tag accounts as "private-not-public" and delay marketing.
ops-bot: created task #4221: generate SKU mapping CSV and staging tokens. ETA 24h.
Owen Park: technical workaround  allow activation with temporary token that maps to current metered SKU; swap to marketplace SKU when metadata uploaded. log change for audit.
Sam (Legal): add appendix B: SKU mapping & 60-day deprecation notice. I will draft redlines.
Riya (Finance): I'll run a quick P&L impact scenario with the cap and share by EOD.
Claire Gomez: action items: Sam draft T&Cs, Riya model cap, Owen implement token path, ops-bot confirm task. reconvene tomorrow 9am PT.
